newsitem.title: ITALY: Kredietbank to buy San Paolo stake - report.
newsitem.headline: Kredietbank to buy San Paolo stake - report.

text.p: Belgium's Kredietbank will take a two percent stake in Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino to form part of the Italian bank's core of stable shareholders, newsagency Ansa said, quoting a San Paolo statement.
San Paolo officials were not immediately available for comment.

Earlier this month, San Paolo said Banco Santander, Fiat holding IFI, Italian banks IMI and Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena, and Italian insurer Reale Mutua Assicurazioni would join the core of shareholders.
Santander, IFI and IMI will take five percent each and Paschi and Reale will take three percent each.
IMI announced on Wednesday it had bought a three percent stake in San Paolo for the equivalent of 10,300 lire per share. It already holds some two percent of the group.
The core of shareholders is being set up ahead of the privatisation of San Paolo slated for later this year. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
